census.model: The approved release contract identifies launch countries, customers, supported incoming/outgoing call journeys, emergency obligations, paid-service budget and source/deployment ownership before paid provisioning or public exposure.
census.method: Review the retained owner decisions, provider capabilities and dated source/runtime inventory; compare each promised user journey with its implementation and evidence route.
census.driftMarkers: A required choice is silently assumed, the old browser-only shipment is treated as PSTN proof, or service is represented as primary-phone replacement without an approved emergency/compliance route.

authorReview.outcome: observable behavior/state/guarantee; no diff alone observes the listed failure
authorReview.goalClause: Approved public-service launch contract
authorReview.concreteFailure: Paid provisioning occurs without an approved launch country or spending contract.

census.model: A signed-in user at app.papercusp.com exchanges bidirectional audio with the self-hosted media plane from an external network, including a UDP-blocked network using TURN/TLS.
census.method: Run authenticated remote-browser real-microphone calls on home broadband and cellular, then with UDP blocked; retain ICE-selected transport, WSS origin, peer audio receipt and lifecycle evidence.
census.driftMarkers: One-way/no audio, an insecure or loopback browser endpoint, failed certificate renewal, or dependence on LAN/hairpin connectivity.

authorReview.outcome: observable behavior/state/guarantee; no diff alone observes the listed failure
authorReview.goalClause: Self-hosted publicly reachable two-way media
authorReview.concreteFailure: External UDP-blocked call has one-way audio despite successful room join.

rerun.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import json, hashlib, pathlib
root = pathlib.Path.cwd()
review = json.loads((root / 'docs/evidence/phone-author-vetting-publication-review-2026-10-02.json').read_text())
scope = review['preservedScope']
raw = (root / scope['path']).read_bytes()
assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() == scope['sha256']
snapshot = json.loads(raw)
criteria = snapshot['subjectRubric']['criteria']
by_key = {c['barKey']: c for c in criteria}
expected = {'R-' + str(i) for i in range(1, 88)}
assert len(criteria) == len(by_key) == 87 and set(by_key) == expected
assert {r['barKey'] for r in review['census']} == expected
assert len(review['census']) == 87
for row in review['census']:
    original = by_key[row['barKey']]
    for field in ['model', 'method', 'driftMarkers', 'check']:
        assert row[field] == original[field], (row['barKey'], field)
    assert row['sourceRefs'] == original['intent']['sourceRefs']
    assert row['authorReview']['concreteFailure']
    assert row['authorReview']['goalClause'] and row['authorReview']['decisions']
files = {f['path']: f for f in snapshot['sourceScope']['files']}
for path, f in files.items():
    assert hashlib.sha256(f['content'].encode()).hexdigest() == f['sha256'], path
missing = {}
control = {}
for key in ['R-12', 'R-74']:
    check = by_key[key]['check']['files']
    wanted = review['structuredDowngrade']['missingBindableFiles']
    missing[key] = [p for p in wanted if p not in check]
    assert missing[key] == wanted
    repaired = list(dict.fromkeys(check + wanted))
    control[key] = [p for p in wanted if p not in repaired]
    assert control[key] == []
anchors = {
 'apps/sidecar/src/voicemail-persistence.e2e.test.ts': [
   'expect((await read("/api/voicemail", "tenant-a")).voicemails).toEqual(saved);',
   'expect(replay.status).toBe(410);',
   'segments: [], voicemail: null',
   'expect((await read("/api/calls/search?q=privatedeletee2e", "tenant-a")).hits).toEqual([]);'],
 'packages/data/src/call-deletion.integration.test.ts': [
   'rejects.toThrow("phone_content_deleted")',
   'expect(await store.exportCallContent(call.id)).toEqual(before);',
   'rejects.toThrow("fixture_deletion_failure")']
}
found = {}
for path, needles in anchors.items():
    content = files[path]['content']
    found[path] = {}
    for needle in needles:
        lines = [i for i,line in enumerate(content.splitlines(),1) if needle in line]
        assert lines, (path, needle)
        found[path][needle] = lines
keys = set(by_key)
decision_census = review['decisionInverse']
assert [d['decision'] for d in decision_census] == ['D-' + str(i).zfill(3) for i in range(1,10)]
for d in decision_census:
    assert d['coverage'] and set(d['coverage']) <= keys
    assert d['decision'] in snapshot['planDecisions']
pairs = review['pairwiseReview']
assert pairs['population'] == 87*86//2
assert len(pairs['checked']) + pairs['notSemanticallyChecked'] == pairs['population']
for pair in pairs['checked']:
    assert set(pair['pair']) <= keys
    assert set(pair['ratings'].values()) == {'broken','healthy'}
print(json.dumps({'snapshotSha256':scope['sha256'],'criteriaChecked':87,'embeddedHashesChecked':len(files),
 'decisionRowsChecked':len(decision_census), 'missingBindingFiles':missing,'membershipPositiveControl':control,
 'assertionAnchors':found,'semanticPairSpotChecks':pairs['checked'],'unreviewedSemanticPairs':pairs['notSemanticallyChecked'],
 'limitation':'This executable validates exact scope, census shape, assertion anchors and binding mismatch. Semantic judgments are explicit review rows; it does not run software, prove all detectors adequate, or certify public shipment.'}, indent=2))
